home_subtitle: 第四课 · 写家乡故事
part1_desc: 第 1–21 步：跟站长学写家乡故事，练 since/for、写变化三句型和连接词。
part2_desc: 第 22–44 步：独立完成老房子资料题，再闯 12 道挑战题（混了被动语态和比较级、最高级），最后写一整段家乡故事。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：用 since/for 与完成时写家乡变化、被动语态写建造、最高级、连接词；挑战段混练被动语态与比较级/最高级，课末有一段 3 信息点家乡故事写作。Unit 6 Wisdom counts 主题。

steps.title: 写自己的故事
steps.teach_html:
古代故事第四期，站长说：听了这么多古代故事，这期你来写——我的家乡故事！

hometown 是“家乡”，village 是“村庄”。用学过的 since 和 for，把家乡的故事写下来。

steps.title: 写作用 since/for
steps.teach_html:
写“一直持续到现在”的事，用完成时 + since/for：

My family has lived here since 1998.（我家从1998年起住在这里。）
We have kept old photos for many years.（我们存旧照片很多年了。）

steps.title: 三部分结构
steps.teach_html:
写故事分三部分：

① 开头：介绍家乡（My hometown is…）。
② 中间：讲故事、讲变化（过去时讲过去的事，完成时讲持续到现在的事）。
③ 结尾：说感受（I love… / I am proud of…）。

proud 是“自豪的”。

steps.title: 连接词
steps.teach_html:
三个常用连接词：

and（和）连两件事；but（但是）转折；because（因为）说原因。

I love my hometown because it is old and beautiful.（我爱家乡，因为它古老又美丽。）

steps.title: 范文句子
steps.teach_html:
看范文里的句子：

My grandpa was born in this village.（我爷爷出生在这个村子。）grandpa 是“爷爷”。

He has lived here since 1960.（他从1960年起住在这里。）

steps.title: 时态提醒
steps.teach_html:
写作时态提醒：

写“过去发生、结束了”→ 过去时（was born, moved）。
写“从过去持续到现在”→ 完成时（has lived since…, have kept for…）。

steps.title: 写变化三句型
steps.teach_html:
写家乡的变化，有三个好用的句型：

① 变化：Our town has changed a lot.（小镇变化很大。）My hometown has become more beautiful.（家乡变得更美了。）
② 建造：The bridge was built in 1930.（桥建于1930年——桥是被建成的，用被动。）
③ 最……：It is the oldest building in the village.（它是村里最古老的建筑。）

下面的练习和挑战都会用到这三个句型。

steps.title: 范文
steps.teach_html:
小范文（自编）：

My hometown is a small village. It is very old. My grandpa was born here. He has lived here since 1960. Our family has kept old photos for many years. I love my hometown because it is beautiful.

六句话，开头+中间+结尾，齐了。

steps.title: 写作检查清单
steps.teach_html:
写完检查三件事：

① 用了 since/for 吗？② 时态对吗（过去的事过去时，持续到现在完成时）？③ 单词拼对了吗？

下面先练基本功，再自己写。

steps.title: 先看资料
steps.teach_html:
这是林涛家乡的资料卡。做题时对照着看：林涛的家乡是个小村庄，他家从1980年起住在那里，存了很多老物件。

下面站长带着你练写作基本功。
steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 从1998年
steps.scene: 我家从1998年起住在这里。
steps.stem: My family has lived here ___ 1998.
steps.help: 1998 是时间点。
steps.explain: My family has lived here since 1998.

wrong_feedback.A: 1998 是时间点，用 since，不用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: last 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。
wrong_feedback.D: ago 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 出生
steps.scene: 他1960年出生。
steps.stem: He ___ born in 1960.
steps.help: 1960 年出生，是过去的事。
steps.explain: He was born in 1960.

wrong_feedback.B: is 是现在时，1960 年是过去，用 was。
wrong_feedback.C: has been 是完成时，这里讲过去的事，用 was。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 2010年搬来
steps.scene: 我们2010年搬到这里。
steps.stem: We moved here ___ 2010.
steps.help: “在2010年”，过去的时间。
steps.explain: We moved here in 2010.

wrong_feedback.A: moved 是过去时，不用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: moved 是过去时，不用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: ago 前面不加 in，直接说 years ago。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 从1998年
steps.scene: 我家从1998年起住在这里。
steps.stem: My family has lived here ___ 1998.
steps.help: 1998 是时间点。
steps.explain: My family has lived here since 1998.

common_errors.say: 1998 是时间点，用 since；for 后面跟一段时间（如 many years）。
from 不能这样表示“自从某年起”；完成时里“从1998年起”用 since。
in 1998 是过去时的说法，要配过去时；这里是 has lived 完成时，用 since。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 1960年出生
steps.scene: 他1960年出生。
steps.stem: He ___ (be) born in 1960.
steps.help: 1960 年是过去。
steps.explain: He was born in 1960.

common_errors.say: 1960 年出生是过去的事，be 动词用过去式 was，不用 is。
出生是一次性的过去动作，不能说 has been born；用 was born。
be 是原形，不能直接放进句子；出生要用 was born 里的 was。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 因为
steps.scene: 我爱它，因为它很古老。
steps.stem: I love it ___ it is old.
steps.help: 表示原因。
steps.explain: I love it because it is old.

common_errors.say: so 是“所以”，方向反了；这里是给出爱它的原因，用 because。
but 是转折；“爱它，因为它古老”是原因，用 because。
and 只是并列两件事，不表示原因；说原因要用 because。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 认识五年
steps.scene: 我们认识五年了。
steps.stem: We have known each other ___ five years.
steps.help: 五年是时间段。
steps.explain: We have known each other for five years.

common_errors.say: five years 是一段时间，用 for；since 后面跟时间点（如 2020）。
from 不表示持续了多久；持续五年用 for。
in five years 是“五年后”，是将来的意思；已经认识五年了用 for。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 变化很大
steps.scene: 村子这些年变化很大。
steps.stem: The village has ______ (change) a lot in the last ten years.
steps.task: 写 change 的正确形式。
steps.help: has 后面跟动词的哪种形式？想想 change 的过去分词。
steps.explain: The village has changed a lot in the last ten years.

common_errors.say: has 后面要用过去分词 changed；动词原形 change 不能直接跟在 has 后面。
changing 是现在分词；has 后面用过去分词，写 changed。
changes 是第三人称单数的现在时；完成时是 has + 过去分词，写 changed。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 老桥建成
steps.scene: 村里的老桥是 1930 年建成的。
steps.stem: The old bridge in the village ______ in 1930.
steps.help: 先想：桥是自己建自己的，还是被建成的？再看时间是 1930 年还是现在。
steps.explain: The old bridge in the village was built in 1930.

wrong_feedback.A: built 是主动语态的过去式，意思是桥自己建自己；桥是被建成的，要用被动 was built。
wrong_feedback.C: has built 还是主动，意思是“桥建了别的”；而且 1930 是过去的时间点，被动要用 was built。
wrong_feedback.D: is building 是“正在建”，主动而且是现在；1930 年建成的事要用过去被动 was built。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 最干净的河
steps.scene: 河比以前干净了，是我们镇上最干净的河。
steps.stem: The river is ______ than before, and it is ______ river in our town.
steps.task: 写出两个空里的词（第一个空一个词，第二个空两个词）。
steps.answer_text: The river is cleaner than before, and it is the cleanest river in our town.
steps.help: 先分清两个空：第一个是跟以前比，第二个是全镇范围里最……。
steps.explain: The river is cleaner than before, and it is the cleanest river in our town.

common_errors.say: 第一个空后面有 than，是跟以前比，用比较级 cleaner；最高级留给第二个空。
第二个空是全镇最干净的，要用最高级 the cleanest，不能用比较级。

common_errors.when: 写了 more cleaner 或 more cleanest
common_errors.say: clean 是单音节词，直接加 er/est：cleaner、cleanest，前面不能再加 more。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 爷爷讲过吗
steps.scene: 问：爷爷给你讲过这个故事吗？
steps.stem: ______ your grandpa ever told you this story?
steps.help: 先数主语是一个人还是多个人，再看 told 是动词的什么形式。
steps.explain: Has your grandpa ever told you this story?

common_errors.say: 主语 your grandpa 是一人（第三人称单数），疑问句句首要用 Has，不用 Have。
Did 后面要跟动词原形 tell，跟不了 told；表示经历用 Has。
Is 后面跟不了 told 组成完成时；问“讲过没有”要用 Has 开头。

steps.reading: Lin Tao's hometown is a small village. His family has lived there since 1980. They have kept many old things for years.

steps.title: 新任务：独立写
steps.teach_html:
新任务来了：这次是小梅奶奶的老房子的资料。

资料在上面。这次你自己看、自己答，站长不提示了。

记住：since + 时间点，for + 时间段；过去的事用过去时。
steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 从1975年
steps.scene: 她奶奶从1975年起住在老房子里。
steps.stem: Her grandma has lived there ___ 1975.
steps.help: 时间点。
steps.explain: Her grandma has lived there since 1975.

wrong_feedback.B: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for many years）；1975 是时间点，用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: last 是过去时的标志词，要配过去时；这里是 has lived 完成时，“从1975年起”用 since。
wrong_feedback.D: ago 是过去时的标志词（如 two years ago）；完成时讲“从某时起”用 since。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 四十多年
steps.scene: 这家人有这房子四十多年了。
steps.stem: The family has had the house ___ over 40 years.
steps.help: 时间段。
steps.explain: The family has had the house for over 40 years.

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟时间点；over 40 years 是一段时间，用 for。
wrong_feedback.B: last 不能这样直接跟 over 40 years；持续四十多年用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: ago 说的是过去的时间点（40 years ago 是四十年前的那一刻）；这里是持续四十多年到现在，用 for。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 1980年买
steps.scene: 他们1980年买的房子。
steps.stem: They bought the house ___ 1980.
steps.help: 过去的时间。
steps.explain: They bought the house in 1980.

wrong_feedback.A: since 要配完成时；bought 是过去时，说哪一年买的用 in 1980。
wrong_feedback.B: for 表示持续的一段时间；这里是 1980 这个年份点，用 in。
wrong_feedback.D: ago 前面要有一段时间（如 two years ago）；直接跟年份 1980 用 in。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 从小时候
steps.scene: 她从小时候就存照片。
steps.stem: She has kept photos ___ she was young.
steps.help: since 可跟句子。
steps.explain: She has kept photos since she was young.

wrong_feedback.A: last 是过去时的标志词；这里是 has kept 完成时，引出起点用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: ago 是过去时的标志词，要配过去时；完成时里“自从”用 since。
wrong_feedback.D: for 后面跟一段时间；空后面是“she was young”这个起点句子，用 since。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 出生在这
steps.scene: 他出生在这所房子里。
steps.stem: He ___ born in this house.
steps.help: 过去的事。
steps.explain: He was born in this house.

wrong_feedback.A: is 是现在时；他出生是过去的事，be 动词用过去式 was。
wrong_feedback.B: has been born 不对，出生是一次性的过去动作，要用 was born。
wrong_feedback.C: be 是动词原形，不能直接放进句子；出生要用 was。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 但是
steps.scene: 房子很旧，但是我爱它。
steps.stem: The house is old, ___ I love it.
steps.help: 表示转折。
steps.explain: The house is old, but I love it.

common_errors.say: 前后不是原因关系：房子旧、我却爱它，是转折，用 but。
and 只是并列，体现不出“虽然旧却爱它”的转折；转折用 but。
so 引出结果，方向不对；这里是让步转折，用 but。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 四十年
steps.scene: 他们有这房子四十年了。
steps.stem: They have had it ___ 40 years.
steps.help: 时间段。
steps.explain: They have had it for 40 years.

common_errors.say: 40 years 是一段时间，用 for；since 后面跟时间点。
from 不表示持续时间；有这房子四十年了用 for。
last 要跟具体的一段时间（如 last year）；这里直接跟 40 years，用 for。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 从2010年
steps.scene: 我们从2010年起住在这里。
steps.stem: We have lived here ___ 2010.
steps.help: 时间点。
steps.explain: We have lived here since 2010.

common_errors.say: 2010 是时间点，用 since；for 后面跟一段时间。
from 不能表示“自从某年起持续到现在”；完成时用 since。
in 2010 要配过去时；句子是 have lived 完成时，用 since。

steps.reading: Mei's grandma has lived in the old house since 1975. The family has had the house for over 40 years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 小镇变化大
steps.scene: 写家乡的变化：小镇这些年变化很大。
steps.stem: Our town has ______ (change) a lot in the last ten years.
steps.task: 写 change 的正确形式。
steps.help: has 后面跟动词的哪种形式？先想 change 的过去分词怎么写。
steps.explain: Our town has changed a lot in the last ten years.

common_errors.say: has 后面要用过去分词 changed；原形 change 不能直接跟在 has 后面。
changing 是现在分词；完成时 has 后面用过去分词 changed。
changes 是现在时三单形式；这里是完成时，写 changed。

steps.title: 挑战 · 家乡变美了
steps.scene: 写家乡的变化：我的家乡变成了美丽的地方。
steps.stem: My hometown ______ a beautiful place these years.
steps.help: “变成了”是从过去到现在的结果，想想 become 的过去分词和句首助动词。
steps.explain: My hometown has become a beautiful place these years.

common_errors.say: became 是过去式，只说过去变过；“这些年变成了”是持续到现在的结果，要用 has become。
has 后面用过去分词：become 的过去分词还是 become，写 has become。
is 不能和 become 组成完成时；表示变化的结果用 has become。

steps.title: 挑战 · 从小住到现在
steps.scene: 奶奶从还是个小女孩时起就住在老房子里。
steps.stem: Grandma has lived in the old house ______ she was a little girl.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的是一个起点句子，还是一段时间。
steps.explain: Grandma has lived in the old house since she was a little girl.

common_errors.say: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for ten years）；空后面是“she was a little girl”这个起点，用 since。
from 不能这样带出一个起点句子；“自从……”用 since。
when 只是“在……时候”；从小一直住到现在是持续到现在，用 since。

steps.title: 挑战 · 2019年修的路
steps.scene: 写家乡：2019 年，一条新路修到了我们村。
steps.stem: A new road ______ to our village in 2019.
steps.task: 写出空里的两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先看时间是 2019 年还是现在，再想路是自己修的还是被修的。
steps.explain: A new road was built to our village in 2019.

common_errors.say: built 是主动语态的过去式；路是被修的，被动语态不能少 be 动词：was built。
is built 是现在的被动；修路是 2019 年的事，要用 was built。
be 动词后面要用过去分词：build 的过去分词是 built，写 was built。

steps.title: 挑战 · 村里最老的树
steps.scene: 写家乡：这棵老树是我们村里最老的树。
steps.stem: This old tree is ______ tree in our village.
steps.help: 先看范围：是在全村的树里面比，还是只跟一棵树比？
steps.explain: This old tree is the oldest tree in our village.

common_errors.say: older 是比较级，跟一棵树比才用；全村范围里“最老的”要用最高级 the oldest。
old 是单音节词，最高级直接加 est：oldest，不用 most。
oldest 本身已经是最高级，前面不能再加 most。

steps.title: 挑战 · 镇上最美的地方
steps.scene: 写家乡：湖是我们镇上最美的地方。
steps.stem: The lake is ______ place in our town.
steps.help: 先看范围：全镇里最……，beautiful 是长词还是短词？
steps.explain: The lake is the most beautiful place in our town.

common_errors.say: more beautiful 是比较级，跟一个地方比才用；全镇“最美的”要用最高级 the most beautiful。
beautiful 是多音节词，最高级要在前面加 most，不能在词尾加 est。
多音节词用 most 构成最高级，词尾不要再加 er：the most beautiful。

steps.title: 挑战 · 家乡上过故事书吗
steps.scene: 问：你的家乡上过有名的故事书吗？
steps.stem: ______ your hometown ever been in a famous story?
steps.help: 先看主语 your hometown 是一个还是多个，再看 been 是什么形式。
steps.explain: Has your hometown ever been in a famous story?

common_errors.say: 主语 your hometown 是一个地方（第三人称单数），疑问句句首要用 Has，不用 Have。
Is 后面跟不了 been 组成完成时；问“上过没有”要用 Has 开头。
Did 后面要跟动词原形 be，跟不了 been；表示经历用 Has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 保存了三百年
steps.scene: 人们把这口老井保存了三百年。
steps.stem: People have ______ (keep) this old well for 300 years.
steps.task: 写 keep 的正确形式。
steps.help: have 后面用过去分词；keep 是不规则动词，先想它的过去分词怎么写。
steps.explain: People have kept this old well for 300 years.

common_errors.say: keep 是不规则动词，过去分词是 kept，不能加 ed。
keep 是原形；have 后面要用过去分词 kept。
keeping 是现在分词；have 后面用过去分词 kept。

steps.title: 挑战 · 爷爷的一生
steps.scene: 爷爷 1950 年出生在这个村子，从那时起一直住在这里。
steps.stem: My grandpa ______ in this village in 1950, and he ______ here since then.
steps.help: 先分两个空：第一个是 1950 年一次性的事，第二个是从那时一直到现在。
steps.explain: My grandpa was born in this village in 1950, and he has lived here since then.

wrong_feedback.B: is born 不对：出生是 1950 年的事，要用 was born；而且“从那时起一直住”要用完成时 has lived，不用 lives。
wrong_feedback.C: 第一个空对了。第二个空 lived 是过去时，只说过去住过；since then 是一直到现在，要用 has lived。
wrong_feedback.D: 第一个空少了 was：“出生”要说 was born；第二个空 has lived 是对的。

steps.title: 挑战 · 每年都修的桥
steps.scene: 这座老桥每年都要修一次。
steps.stem: The old bridge ______ every year.
steps.task: 写出空里的两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先看 every year 说明是现在经常发生的事，再想桥是自己修自己还是被人修。
steps.explain: The old bridge is repaired every year.

common_errors.say: repaired 单独放是主动的过去式；桥是被人修的，被动语态要带 be 动词：is repaired。
was 是过去；every year 说明年年都修、现在也一样，用现在的 is repaired。
be 动词后面要用过去分词：repair 的过去分词是 repaired，写 is repaired。

steps.title: 挑战 · 老人讲的故事
steps.scene: 这个故事是很多年前一位老人讲出来的。
steps.stem: The story ______ by an old man long ago.
steps.help: 先看故事是讲别人的，还是被人讲出来的；再看时间 long ago。
steps.explain: The story was told by an old man long ago.

wrong_feedback.A: told 是主动语态，意思是故事去讲别人；故事是被人讲的，要用被动 was told。
wrong_feedback.C: tells 是现在时主动，时间和语态都不对；long ago 的事、又是被讲，用 was told。
wrong_feedback.D: is telling 是“正在讲”，主动且是现在进行；这个故事是过去被人讲出来的，用 was told。

steps.title: 挑战 · 最宽的路
steps.scene: 新路比旧路宽，是我们镇上最宽的路。
steps.stem: The new road is ______ than the old one, and it is ______ road in our town.
steps.task: 写出两个空里的词（第一个空一个词，第二个空两个词）。
steps.answer_text: The new road is wider than the old one, and it is the widest road in our town.
steps.help: 先分清两个空：第一个是新路和旧路两条比，第二个是全镇范围里最……。
steps.explain: The new road is wider than the old one, and it is the widest road in our town.

common_errors.say: 第一个空后面有 than，是两条路比宽窄，用比较级 wider；最高级留给第二个空。
第二个空是全镇最宽的，要用最高级 the widest，不能用比较级。

common_errors.when: 写了 more wider 或 more widest
common_errors.say: wide 是单音节词，直接加 er/est：wider、widest，前面不能再加 more。

steps.title: 写一段：我的家乡故事
steps.scene: 家乡故事会要选故事贴出来。轮到你写一段家乡故事（4–5 句），交给站长。
steps.stem: 写一段家乡故事，必须写到这三件事：① 一样老建筑是什么时候建的，或者家里人从什么时候起住在这里（was built in … / has lived … since …）；② 家乡的一个变化（has changed / has become …）；③ 你为什么喜欢家乡（I love … because …）。
steps.task: 写 4–5 句英文，三件事一件都不能少。
steps.answer_text: My hometown is a small village. The old bridge was built in 1930. Our village has become more beautiful these years. I love my hometown because it is old and quiet.

cn: 建于何时 / 从何时起住在这里

steps.help: 一句一句来：先写老建筑是哪年建的，再写家乡的一个变化，最后一句写你为什么喜欢它。
steps.explain: 范文：My hometown is a small village. The old bridge was built in 1930. Our village has become more beautiful these years. I love my hometown because it is old and quiet.

common_errors.when: 没写建筑是哪年建的、也没写从何时起住在这里
common_errors.say: 三件事少了第一件：补一句 The old bridge was built in 1930. 或者 My family has lived here since 1998.
三件事少了第二件：补一句变化，如 Our village has become more beautiful.（has become + 变得怎么样）。
三件事少了第三件：结尾补一句 I love my hometown because …，把原因说出来。
讲过去的事用过去时没问题，但“变化”和“从那时到现在”要用完成时：has become、has lived since…。

common_errors.when: 变化句里主语是多个人/物却用了 has
common_errors.say: 主语是 I/you/we/they 或复数时，完成时用 have：They have changed a lot. 单数主语才用 has。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
家乡故事写完了。站长说：你的故事里有 since、有 for，时态也对，很完整！
